subject: Re: ICETEA status: decision - v1 ships on the clean subset
body:
All,

Decision for the May 11 close: benchmark v1 ships on the clean 72% subset (the fused pipeline helped but didn't fully close the throughput gap - thanks Tereza, 14h down to 9h). Full-corpus regeneration becomes the first v1.1 item.

Rationale: the causal story doesn't depend on corpus size, it depends on split hygiene - and the de-dup pipeline is exactly what makes the benchmark trustworthy. Linnea, please write the de-dup methodology up as its own section in the docs; the 7% near-duplicate rate is a headline finding for anyone using medical imaging in evaluation, and I want it visible.

Also for the docs: an explicit caution that IHDP/ACIC numbers and fundus-benchmark numbers are not comparable across estimator families - Halima has the details.

Handoff review Friday May 8, then we freeze. Privacy note: the fundus corpus stays internal-only pending Kofi Weber's review; docs should say so.

Dmitri
